1. Select domain profile (`academic`, `clinical-protocol`, `grant-proposal`, `technical-docs`, `general`, or `commit`), intensity (`light` default for `academic`/`clinical-protocol`; `standard` otherwise), and match any author writing sampl

2. Strip leaked AI tokens/UTMs, zero-width/homoglyph Unicode, staging (`not X, but Y`, dramatic closers, staged openers), inflation (`serves as`, Tier 1A words, superficial `-ing` tails), and academic slop (citation laundering, manuscript b

3. For `paraphrase`, list key points from `--source`, draft from the point list without looking at the source, keep citations attached and direct quotes in quotation marks, maintain `0.7x-1.3x` length parity, and eliminate `>=8`-word non-qu
4. Run a metacognitive self-audit (*"What still makes this read as LLM-generated, and did any edit introduce Group G meaning drift?"*) and targeted second pass.

5. Run `audit_prose.py` (`--ignore-references`, `--compare <before>`, `--source <source>` for paraphrases, and `--strict`) to confirm zero dropped/altered numbers, negations, hedges, scope words, scripts, or citations.
